aggregation_identity.definition: residual = unrounded all-groups NSA percent change minus sum over expenditure classes of (contribution(t-1)/all-groups index(t-1)) * class NSA percent change. Weights are not renormalised.
aggregation_identity.weight_note: CPI_WEIGHTS observation dates in this project are annual basket updates (through 2024-Q4). Price-updated MEASURE 4 contributions already apply the basket in force. A month is listed as a link/reweight candidate only when the full-coverage absolute residual exceeds 0.02 percentage points. The September 2025 index reference (all-groups original = 100) is a level rebase; the month-to-month identity is still the check used here.

base_effects_sep_2025.meaning: Each contribution is the class share of the 2025-09 all-groups NSA percent change. That month drops out of the year-ended rate when the same month of the following year is published.

top_10_by_absolute_contribution.name: Other services in respect of motor vehicles

periods.contribution_note: MEASURE 4 is the contribution to the CPI index number, which is present from 2024-12. MEASURE 6 (contribution to the percentage-point change) was not in the snapshot. derived_contribution_to_mom_pp = (contribution_t - contribution_t-1) / all-groups index_t-1 * 100 and is labeled derived.
MEASURE 4 contribution to the CPI index number at this period.

sensitivity.treatment_note: Electricity (class 40055) does not use a September seasonal factor. The class forecast is the mean of its last 3 or 6 seasonally adjusted month-to-month changes (original changes if no SA index is available). A seasonal-naive or implied-seasonal path would import the 2025 rebate-timing pattern. No month is dropped as rebate-affected: the snapshot has official index levels and contribution levels, not an official rebate flag or a rebate amount. Sensitivity rows recompute the class and its all-groups contribution under the seasonal alternatives.

forecast_contributors.note: The selected headline model has no class split. These rows are the component_bottom_up_3 diagnostic, not the selected number.

headline_coherence.note: The selected NSA model and the selected SA model can embed different SA paths. mom_gap_pp is the selected NSA MoM minus the NSA MoM obtained by applying the all-groups seasonal movement to the selected SA forecast. Neither selected value is replaced.

index_publication_convention.convention: Models and unrounded outputs use the percent change implied by published index levels. value_1dp is that unrounded percent rounded half-up to one decimal, which is the ABS display precision. On each series below, the published percent change equals that one-decimal rounding wherever both the index change and the published change exist.
index_publication_convention.rounding: ROUND_HALF_UP to 1 decimal via decimal.Decimal, not Python bankers' round

gap_on_overlap_using_actual_months.label: proxy_bridge_non_equivalent
gap_on_overlap_using_actual_months.note: The bridge is the percent change in the average of the three monthly trimmed-mean index levels. The legacy quarterly trimmed mean is a different statistic. The bridge is not a candidate under the pre-registered selection rule.

quarterly_bridge.note: This is a quarter-average of the monthly trimmed-mean index, not the legacy quarterly trimmed mean. It is excluded from the pre-registered candidate set.

sa_aggregate_gap_vs_999901.definition: gap = unrounded INDEX 999901 percent change minus the contribution-weighted sum of class SA percent changes (original change if the class has no SA index). This gap is the indirect-adjustment residual, carried explicitly in component_sa forecasts.

seasonal_factors.all_groups_seasonal_source: implied NSA/SA index ratio from the same month last year. Table 8 is an expenditure-class factor file and has no all-groups column.

provenance.label: mirror:web.archive.org August 2026 Table 8 (640108), combined seasonal factors

seasonal_factors.reason: Table 8 factors end at 2026-08. 0 of 87 classes have a factor in 2026-09, so the target month is not a forward-factor month. Class seasonal movements are the implied NSA/SA index ratio versus the same month a year earlier.

trim_reconstruction.coverage_note: Class MEASURE 4 contributions in this snapshot start at 2024-12. A t-1 weight therefore cannot be formed before the following month. Published monthly trimmed-mean MoM periods: 2024-05..2026-08 (28). Months without a contribution weight are omitted rather than filled in.
trim_reconstruction.g5_rule: pass only if the primary variant's rounded MoM matches on >=90% of >=12 months and max abs error versus the unrounded index MoM is <= 0.05 pp

quarterly_legacy_equivalence.note: Compared published QoQ percent changes (CPI_Q MEASURE 2 INDEX 999902, RBA G1 series GCPIOCPMTMQP, and Appendix 1a when the June 2026 workbook was parsed). This is not a claim that the monthly trimmed mean equals the quarterly legacy trimmed mean.

variants.description: SA class MoM where a TSEST 20 index exists for both months, else original MoM; price-updated weight = MEASURE 4 contribution at t-1 divided by the all-groups original index at t-1, then normalised over classes with both a weight and a change. 15% of weight trimmed from each tail with partial boundary weights.
Original (TSEST 10) class MoM for every class; same t-1 contribution weights.
Same SA-else-original price changes; weights from contribution(t-2) / all-groups index(t-2).

unmodeled_risks: No official pre-release automotive-fuel series is in the snapshot. Fuel enters only through its class history.

No official electricity rebate amount or month-level rebate flag is in the snapshot. The component model uses a non-seasonal recent mean for class 40055 and reports sensitivity; it does not subtract a rebate.
Domestic holiday travel (40101) and international holiday travel (40102) use the class seasonal movement described in seasonal_factors.
Pseudo-OOS history is the latest vintage, so seasonal-factor revisions can leak into lagged SA indexes. It is not a real-time vintage backtest.

methodology_boundaries.selection_rule: Per target, eligible candidates are models with pseudo-OOS n >= 12 in the target regime. MAE for those candidates and the simplest baseline is computed on the intersection of their target periods. If that common sample has n < 12, use the baseline (common_sample_below_12). Otherwise pick the lowest common-sample MAE only when it beats the baseline's common-sample MAE by at least 0.02 percentage points; otherwise use the baseline. The simplest baseline is seasonal_naive for headline_nsa_mom and persistence for every other change target. Year-ended rates inherit the selected change model via index arithmetic. Bands use the selected model's full walk-forward errors, not the common sample. proxy_bridge_non_equivalent is excluded from the candidate set. The earlier unequal-sample rule is still computed and reported as selection_unequal_sample_legacy.
methodology_boundaries.weighted_median_monthly: shadow diagnostic only; not a scored target

headline_nsa_mom.rule: Per target, eligible candidates are models with pseudo-OOS n >= 12 in the target regime. MAE for those candidates and the simplest baseline is computed on the intersection of their target periods. If that common sample has n < 12, use the baseline (common_sample_below_12). Otherwise pick the lowest common-sample MAE only when it beats the baseline's common-sample MAE by at least 0.02 percentage points; otherwise use the baseline. The simplest baseline is seasonal_naive for headline_nsa_mom and persistence for every other change target. Year-ended rates inherit the selected change model via index arithmetic. Bands use the selected model's full walk-forward errors, not the common sample. proxy_bridge_non_equivalent is excluded from the candidate set. The earlier unequal-sample rule is still computed and reported as selection_unequal_sample_legacy.

headline_nsa_mom.band_note: 68/90 bands use this model's full walk-forward errors (n). Selection MAE uses the common sample (n_common_sample).
caveats: Pseudo-OOS metrics use the latest vintage with periods before the target (seasonal-factor revisions can leak). They are not mixed with the true-vintage row.
value is the unrounded percent change implied by the model. value_1dp rounds that number half-up to one decimal, which is the ABS display convention.
low_sample: the walk-forward sample has n < 20, so the error band is descriptive rather than a stable quantile.
The 68% and 90% bands are empirical absolute-error quantiles of this model's full walk-forward errors, with a floor of 0.05 percentage points. Selection uses the common sample, which can be smaller.
Electricity rebate timing is not a separate official series. component_bottom_up replaces class 40055 seasonality with a recent SA mean; seasonal_naive does not.
Pre-2025-Q4 official quarterly indexes are a re-referenced legacy quarterly CPI and are NOT the quarter-average-of-monthly NSA transform used here.

From 2025-Q4 onward the published quarterly headline index matches the average of published two-decimal monthly indexes within rounding; see the identity report at docs/au_cpi_release/provenance/2026-10-21T183259Z-abs-cpi-headline-quarterly.
The point forecast uses quarter averages of published monthly indexes, including the model level for the release month.
